_what: What contract 146.0.0 moved in the metric roster, measured 2026-11-02 by the re-extraction at 146.0.1 (326 metrics; refresh_metric_contracts.py reported retired [] and 326 written; docs/plans/2026-11-02-omega-reextraction-146.md). `added` is the 24 keys the 146.0.0 stage schema added to $defs/metricKey (recorded by name, unmeasured, in OMEGA v0.10.2 on 2026-11-01), `added_detail` the served hints (get_metric_construction_hints, 2026-11-02) and vocabulary (list_strategy_vocabulary, 2026-11-02). None retired. `sectionSubjects` is the new axis: a custom section's `marketScope` selects its subject, and each subject reads its own metric domain, served in the refusal (data/audit/market_section_probe_146_2026-11-02.json). The vendor README stops at v143; 146 is undocumented there.

CROWD_ACC_EDGE_Z.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
CROWD_ACC_EDGE_Z.gloss: how far the crowd’s accuracy on this coin sits from a coin flip (50%), in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells

CROWD_ACC_EDGE_Z_LIVE.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
CROWD_ACC_EDGE_Z_LIVE.gloss: how far the crowd’s accuracy on this coin sits from a coin flip (50%), in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells; provisional while the sessions run, an unresolved cell counting as not correct

CROWD_CAPT_EXCESS_Z.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
CROWD_CAPT_EXCESS_Z.gloss: how far the share of this coin’s cells that are captained sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or never or always captains

CROWD_CAPT_EXCESS_Z_LIVE.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
CROWD_CAPT_EXCESS_Z_LIVE.gloss: how far the share of this coin’s cells that are captained sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or never or always captains

CROWD_UP_EXCESS_Z.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
CROWD_UP_EXCESS_Z.gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or unanimous

CROWD_UP_EXCESS_Z_LIVE.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
CROWD_UP_EXCESS_Z_LIVE.gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or unanimous

CROWD_UP_LEAN_Z.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
CROWD_UP_LEAN_Z.gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from 50%, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells

CROWD_UP_LEAN_Z_LIVE.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
CROWD_UP_LEAN_Z_LIVE.gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from 50%, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells

MKT_ABOVE_EMA.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_ABOVE_EMA.gloss: share of the scope's coins closing above their own EMA(50) (%), over the coins whose EMA has warmed — the persistent breadth state: it holds its reading for runs of bars where net breadth flips almost every bar, and its zone reads risk-off at 20 or below and risk-on at 80 or above

MKT_AVG_CHG.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_AVG_CHG.gloss: mean close-change across the scope (%), signed

MKT_AVG_PPO.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_AVG_PPO.gloss: mean PPO histogram across the scope, signed

MKT_DISPERSION.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_DISPERSION.gloss: spread of close-change across the scope (%, standard deviation) — how much the field disagrees; low means the coins moved together and a cohort-wide read describes them, high means the mean hides a wide range and the field is moving further per bar

MKT_DOWN.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_DOWN.gloss: share of the scope's coins that closed down (%), over the universe it was measured across

MKT_NET.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_NET.gloss: net breadth — the up share minus the down share (%), signed; negative is a broadly red field

MKT_PPO_DOWN.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_PPO_DOWN.gloss: share of the scope's coins carrying a negative PPO histogram (%), over the coins that have one

MKT_PPO_NET.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_PPO_NET.gloss: net momentum breadth — the positive-histogram share minus the negative (%), signed; negative is a field losing momentum

MKT_PPO_UP.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_PPO_UP.gloss: share of the scope's coins carrying a positive PPO histogram (%), over the coins that have one

MKT_STRETCH.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_STRETCH.gloss: mean RSI(14) across the scope — how extended the field already is, and a slow-moving state rather than a reversal trigger: elevated readings have tended to persist and to run with the move, not against it; the reading is sharpest on the tight crypto cohorts, since averaging the whole tracked universe pulls it toward the midpoint

MKT_UNIVERSE.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_UNIVERSE.gloss: the number of the scope's coins the price shares were measured over — the base of every share, published beside it so the base stays visible

MKT_UP.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_UP.gloss: share of the scope's coins that closed up (%), over the universe it was measured across

MKT_VOL_NET.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
MKT_VOL_NET.gloss: mean relative volume across the scope, each coin against its own 20-bar baseline (1.0 = the field at its own normal, 2.0 = twice it) — how much of the field is actually participating; on the stock and commodity scopes it also reads whether the underlying cash session is open, since those perps trade when their underlying markets are shut

PAR_DEV.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
PAR_DEV.gloss: a stablecoin pair's deviation from its declared par, ((close − par) / par) × 100, signed, on a section bound to a declared reference pair, read off the pair's own spot tape; its history is seeded at boot from the pair's venue candles, so a lookback beyond the history the store holds reads absent

REGIME_WARNING_CRASH.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
REGIME_WARNING_CRASH.gloss: whether the reading carries the crash warning: raised by a crash reading below the gate (-3) and held by the crash latch until the reading recovers to the exit gate

REGIME_WARNING_DIVERGENCE.source: undocumented (the vendor README stops at v143; battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-01-contract-146.md)
REGIME_WARNING_DIVERGENCE.gloss: whether the reading carries the momentum-divergence warning: momentum diverging from price while the structure is a trend
